_transitions_example.note: the brief asks for a clean cut

_transition_kinds: swipe, swipe-reverse, zoom, spin, spin-zoom-in, spin-zoom-out, hard-cut; sounds: page-turn, flame, whoosh, transition-2

captions._style: font, colours, and size come from the visuals theme; override with accent, font, weight, letter_spacing, font_size

visuals._themes: terminal = house style (dark grid paper, lime #b8ff35, JetBrains Mono, hard shadows); terminal-light = its light variant (light theme: warm paper, green #356e00, black hard shadows; caption keywords on dark-green paper chips); glass = frosted light panel, Montserrat
visuals._overrides: optional: palette {ink, primary, accent, warm, soft, paper, alert, muted, hot}, font, grid (px), tints, panel

outro._doc: End card after the last word: curtain, $ whoami, handles, website. Remove to end on the presenter.
outro._overlap: the curtain starts this long before the footage ends and needs 0.54 s to cover; leave >= 0.6 s of quiet after the last word (trim.overrides)
